releases.name: Pets Survivors
releases.summary: Pets Survivors is a survival roguelike where you battle hordes of monsters and fight to stay alive until time runs out. Choose your pet, pick your favorite weapon, upgrade your abilities, and see how long you can survive!

releases.name: Lamp Clicker
releases.summary: Lamp Clicker is a simple and addictive incremental / idle clicker game where your goal is to build your own… lamp empire.

releases.name: Pro Jank Footy
releases.summary:
Pro Jank Footy is an absurd and over-the-top arcade sports game.

Score a goal? Your opponent picks a game-changing power-up.

Hinder your opponents, increase your footy abilities with powers that give your team strong legs, or turn the gameplay completely on its head by transforming everyone into footballs - the choice is yours!

Outplay, out-kick, and out-jank your mates in local multiplayer. Or, if you’re shy, conquer single-player season mode.

releases.name: ZOMBIE CAM BODY CAM SHOOTER
releases.summary:
Step into the chaos of ZOMBIE CAM: Bodycam Shooter, where every heartbeat counts and the undead are closing in. Feel the tension as you navigate dark corridors, dimly lit streets, and abandoned buildings, every step bringing danger closer.
Arm yourself with a mix of weapons and gear, from rifles and pistols to flashlights and grenades, and adapt on the fly to survive relentless waves of zombies. Each map offers a new challenge, each wave a test of courage—and every second matters.

releases.name: Sacred 2 Remaster
releases.summary:
Ancaria stands on the brink. T-Energy, the mysterious power source that once brought prosperity, now fuels corruption, conflict, and chaos. In the midst of war and betrayal, six heroes rise - each with their own fate, abilities, and path through a living, breathing open world.

In this remaster of the beloved action RPG Sacred 2: Fallen Angel, players return to a massive fantasy realm filled with hundreds of quests, dangerous dungeons, and unique combat arts to master. Battle monstrous creatures, uncover ancient secrets, and shape your character through loot, leveling, and deep customization.

With refined combat mechanics, a modern UI, full controller support, and all expansions included, the remaster brings new life to a fan-favorite - whether you’re revisiting Ancaria or setting foot in it for the first time.

Forge your legend. The fate of Ancaria awaits.

releases.name: The Lord of the Rings: War in the North - Legacy Edition
releases.summary: Step into a darker, grittier Middle-earth. The Lord of the Rings: War in the North™ - Legacy Edition expands Tolkien’s epic legendarium, delving into the brutal, untold story of Agandaûr, a Black Númenórean and servant of Sauron who has rallied an immense force in the ruins of Fornost.

releases.name: Merge Assault
releases.summary:
Merge Monsters. Smash Every Block.

Enter a fast-paced hyper casual merging game where strategy and destruction combine in satisfying arcade action. Build a team of powerful monsters on a 5 by 4 grid and send them charging down lanes packed with breakable blocks. Press dash and every monster rushes forward in its lane, smashing into obstacles, bouncing back, and attacking again until the blocks are destroyed.

Each lane contains different types of blocks, with some requiring far more power to break through than others. As levels progress, the lanes become longer and tougher, challenging you to constantly improve your team and create stronger monsters capable of pushing further than ever before.

Earn coins by destroying blocks during every dash and use them to buy new monsters for your grid. Start with basic level 1 monsters and combine matching monsters together by dragging them onto each other. Every merge creates a stronger monster at the next level, allowing you to continue upgrading all the way up to powerful level 30 monsters.

To complete a stage, at least one monster must smash through every block in its lane and reach the treasure waiting at the end. Claim huge coin rewards, unlock the next challenge, and keep merging to survive increasingly difficult levels filled with stronger obstacles and longer paths.

Easy to learn and satisfying to master, this hyper casual merge game delivers nonstop progression, rewarding upgrades, and addictive destruction with every dash.

releases.name: Bubble Shooter: Color Splash
releases.summary:
One shot. Endless bubble fun!

Ready to pop some bubbles? Match colors, trigger exciting combos, and clear challenging puzzles one shot at a time.

Enjoy intuitive controls, satisfying gameplay, and hundreds of relaxing moments as each level brings new challenges and colorful fun.

releases.name: Jesus Simulator
releases.summary: Jesus Simulator is a narrative driven game that retells the earthly life of Jesus Christ through the events of the Gospel. Become a witness to sermons, miracles, and encounters that explore love, mercy, faith, forgiveness, and sacrifice.

releases.name: Kitties Solitaire
releases.summary:
340 levels of cozy, cuddly card fun.

Curl up with the coziest card game on your console! Kitties Solitaire wraps the classic TriPeaks Solitaire experience in an adorable world of playful cats, warm colors, and charming feline companions.
Clear the peaks one card at a time in this relaxing yet endlessly engaging solitaire adventure. With 340 handcrafted levels, every session brings a fresh challenge — and a new reason to keep those paws tapping.
Features:

Full TriPeaks Solitaire — Master the beloved card system that's easy to learn and satisfying to perfect.
340 Levels — A massive collection designed to keep you playing for hours on end.
Unique Card Layouts — Varied and creative board designs ensure no two levels feel the same, delivering long-term engagement.
Smooth & Responsive — Enjoy fluid animations and tight controls that make every move feel great.
Undo & Rewards — Rethink your strategy with the handy undo system, and collect rewards as you climb each peak.

Whether you're a solitaire veteran or just love cute cats, Kitties Solitaire is the purr-fect way to unwind. Deal yourself in and let the good times paw-r in!

releases.name: Task Force Ranger - Breakpoint
releases.summary:
Task Force Ranger: Breakpoint is a modern military shooter focused on intense combat and high-risk special operations.

Deploy as Bravo Team in the conflict zone of Al-Shamal and carry out a series of dangerous missions against the Jazeera Front. Recover critical intelligence, destroy enemy infrastructure, eliminate hostile leadership, and cripple their ability to operate across the region.

Fight through fortified compounds, industrial facilities, urban districts, and remote mountain strongholds. Expect heavy resistance, armored threats, and large-scale firefights as enemy forces attempt to stop your advance.

Use assault rifles, machine guns, sniper rifles, pistols, explosives, and support weapons to complete your objectives and survive overwhelming odds.

Beyond the campaign, test your skills in Survival Mode, where endless enemy waves push your combat abilities to the limit. Earn money, upgrade your equipment, and see how long you can hold the line.

releases.name: Sandbox Doodle Playground
releases.summary:
Build. Craft. Destroy. Create Your Own Playground. Experiment Without Limits.

Sandbox Doodle Playground, a creative physics sandbox where your imagination becomes reality! Craft, build, experiment, and create endless scenarios using a huge collection of characters, weapons, vehicles, tools, and interactive objects.
Design your own worlds, build incredible machines, or unleash total chaos with realistic ragdoll physics. Every object reacts naturally, allowing you to create funny experiments, epic battles, crazy chain reactions, or peaceful constructions. There are no rules or missions—only unlimited freedom to play your way.
Whether you enjoy engineering complex contraptions, testing physics, or simply creating hilarious moments, Sandbox Doodle Playground gives you all the tools you need.

Features:
Creative physics sandbox with realistic interactions.
Draw and build your own unique playground.
Hundreds of objects, weapons, vehicles, and tools.
Realistic ragdoll physics and destructible environments.
Create machines, traps, battles, and chain reactions.
Endless possibilities with no limits or objectives.
Easy-to-use controls for players of all ages.

releases.name: Prison Escape Simulator 2026
releases.summary:
Can you dig a secret tunnel before the guards discover your plan?

Dig Your Way to Freedom

Trapped behind bars, you have only one chance to escape: dig a secret tunnel beneath your prison cell and reach freedom before the guards discover your plan.

Every day is a careful balancing act. Dig deeper into the ground, hide the tunnel entrance under your cell's carpet, and keep an eye on guard patrols. One mistake is all it takes to get caught, lose progress, and start over.

As you excavate the tunnel, you'll uncover valuable items buried underground. Trade them with the prison cook for soap—the prison's underground currency—and invest in powerful upgrades. Buy better tools to dig faster, increase your carrying capacity, and expand your pockets to secretly transport more dirt.

Managing the excavated soil is just as important as digging. Sneak outside and dispose of it before anyone becomes suspicious. The deeper your tunnel grows, the more careful you'll need to be.

releases.name: Cloud Golf
releases.summary: 『Cloud Golf』は、雲の上の遥か高みへとプレイヤーを誘う、リラックスできて視覚的にも魅力的なミニゴルフゲームです。明るいパステルカラーの空の世界を舞台に、浮遊するコース、なめらかなカーブ、クリエイティブなレイアウト、そして心地よいショットが特徴で、癒やしと楽しさの両方を感じられるよう設計されています。各レベルは、シンプルな操作性、巧妙なコース設計、そして適度な手応えが融合しており、カジュアルなプレイヤーが気軽に楽しめる一方で、正確さとスキルもしっかりと報われます。陽気な雰囲気、柔らかなビジュアル、そして親しみやすいゲームプレイを備えた『Cloud Golf』は、あらゆる年齢層のプレイヤーに、新鮮で平和、そして楽しい、お気楽なミニゴルフ体験をお届けします。

releases.name: Car Dealer Simulator: Retro Car for Sale
releases.summary:
Become a Car Dealer. Trade Classic Cars. Build Your Dealership.

Build your own classic car dealership and become a successful retro car trader! Search for hidden bargains, buy old vehicles, repair and restore them, then sell them for profit. Upgrade your garage, expand your showroom, and grow your business from a small workshop into a thriving dealership.
Discover unique vintage cars, improve their condition, customize their appearance, and negotiate the best deals. Manage your finances wisely, unlock new opportunities, and prove you have what it takes to become the ultimate retro car dealer.

releases.name: Living Shadows
releases.summary:
In a world where humans and their shadows have been separated, the line between reality and despair begins to blur.

Living Shadows is a narrative-driven puzzle adventure that explores sensitive themes such as anxiety, depression, and existential crisis. Follow Theo, a young man trapped in apathy, as he journeys through a desolate city and mysterious landscapes in search of answers—and of himself.

In this fragmented world, Theo's shadow is more than a silhouette—it’s a living reflection of his deepest fears and repressed memories. Interact with it to solve puzzles, uncover hidden truths, and confront the darkness within.

Features:
Emotional storytelling – Uncover a gripping narrative that tackles mental health, anxiety, and the human impact of technology.

Challenging puzzles – Solve atmospheric and symbolic challenges that require thought, logic, and introspection.

Immersive environments – Explore hauntingly beautiful 2.5D locations that mirror the emotional states of the characters.

Unforgettable characters – Meet Theo, the enigmatic Bituca, and others who embody the inner struggles of a fractured society.

Striking visual style – Dark, hand-crafted visuals that bring a dystopian and emotionally rich world to life.

releases.name: Captive
releases.summary:
Leave No Trace. He is Always Watching.

Your worst nightmare has become your reality. You are the latest captive of a notorious, masked serial killer, imprisoned in his grim subterranean dungeon. Through the cracked walls, you can hear the horrifying screams of other victims meeting gruesome ends. Your cell door is just the first obstacle. To survive, you must navigate a house of horrors, solve twisted puzzles, and find a way out before the killer starts up his chainsaw.

Your captor is highly observant and constantly patrols his territory. Stealth and meticulous attention to detail are your only hope. If you open a drawer, pick a lock, or move an object, you must return it exactly as you found it. If he notices even a trace of your escape attempt, he will hunt you down with relentless fury. Navigate the claustrophobic brick hallways by the dim light of your lantern. Squeeze through tight vents and witness the grim machinery of his torture chamber from the shadows. Stay quiet, think logically under pressure, and cover your tracks perfectly. Can you outsmart the ultimate predator, or will you become just another voice screaming in the dark?

releases.name: Zooville Detectives: A Read-Along Mystery
releases.summary:
Discover the secret guardian of Zooville in this heartwarming visual novel.

The badger Dax, who has secretly maintained and cared for Zooville by night for years, finds himself longing for recognition, prompting a young hedgehog named Nell and her companions to uncover the truth and guide him out of the shadows.

♣ Format: A visual novel for kids.
♣ Word Count: Featuring more than 10,000 words.
♣ Target Audience: Ideal for children between 5 and 10 years old.
♣ Experience: Completely free of ads and in-app purchases.
♣ Pacing: Allows you to read at your own pace without any rush.

releases.name: John Fox
releases.summary:
John Fox is an elite warrior and super soldier who saved the leaders of various States. He was a professional mercenary who retired with honor. But now his beloved pet, Milo, has been killed. 

You have to avenge him!

releases.name: Grizzy and the Lemmings - Crazy Party
releases.summary: Grizzy and the Lemmings - Crazy Party is a family-focused party game for one to four players who can choose from 40 different lemming characters to play. The Lemmings compete across 50 zany mini-games, six game modes and five boards, inspired by the series, in a mad race to grab as much Yummy as possible right under Grizzy's nose - and he's not about to let them get away with it!

releases.name: Forgotten Vault
releases.summary:
Enter a forgotten underground vault in this fast-paced pixel-art roguelike shooter. Explore procedurally generated dungeons, collect powerful weapons, battle dangerous enemies.

Descend into a forgotten underground vault where every room hides new dangers, valuable supplies, and terrifying enemies.

Fight your way through five increasingly difficult dungeon levels in a fast-paced, top-down pixel-art roguelike shooter. Each run features procedurally generated rooms, unpredictable encounters, and randomized loot, ensuring that no two expeditions feel exactly the same.

Choose from three playable characters with different strengths, then search the vault for weapons, ammunition, health supplies, and other useful equipment. Expand your arsenal with pistols, shotguns, lasers, rockets, and other weapons, each offering different firing patterns, magazine sizes, and combat possibilities.

Stay mobile, dodge incoming attacks, take cover behind interactive objects, and flip tables to block enemy projectiles. Break containers, open mysterious chests, explore cleared areas using the minimap, and prepare for powerful bosses waiting at the end of every level.

The deeper you travel, the more dangerous the vault becomes. Enemies grow faster, attack more frequently, and appear in greater numbers. Taking damage can also affect your sanity, briefly distorting the world around you and making every battle even more unsettling.

releases.name: Loree 3D
releases.summary:
Waddle into adventure with Loree, a fearless penguin explorer! Race through colorful 3D worlds, dodge obstacles, and collect coins for family fun.

Join Loree, a brave and curious penguin, on a colorful 3D platforming adventure! Wearing his signature red propeller hat and cozy green scarf, Loree waddles, jumps, and glides his way through dozens of imaginative levels packed with challenges, secrets, and surprises.

releases.name: Dark Witch Match!
releases.summary: The first-ever competitive puzzle game from the world of The Legend of Dark Witch! Match blocks, build chains, and overwhelm your rival in a Match-3 battler that's easy to learn but deep to master. Play cross-platform climb the global leaderboards, and dive into Story and Score Attack modes.
